name: optimate-make-cli
description: CLI to fetch, analyze, edit, build, and push Make.com scenario blueprints

scripts.postinstall:
echo '
  make-fixer installed successfully!

  Get started:
    make-fixer login --token <your-make-api-token>

  Claude Code plugin (optional):
    claude plugin marketplace add idokraicer/optimate-plugins
    claude plugin install make-fixer@optimate-plugins
'
